podcast.title: Toots Hibbert's Death (2020)
podcast.body: Toots Hibbert, a foundational figure in reggae, sadly passed away in the fall of 2020 after exhibiting symptoms of COVID-19, adding his name to the list of musical legends lost to the coronavirus pandemic. "Sadly, it seems that he died of COVID-19. He was showing symptoms when he died in the fall of 2020."

podcast.title: First Wave Ska Originator
podcast.body: The Toots and the Maytals were an originator of the "first wave" of Ska, a style born in Jamaica in the 1950s. Along with Desmond Dekker and The Skatalites, these artists comprised the initial pioneers of the genre. "Those originators, Desmond Decker, Tutson the Maytaws, the Scott lights and so on, all from Jamaica comprised that first wave."
